title: Actual exam question for Salesforce's MCAE-Con-201 exam
question: Which are true about Marketing Cloud Account Engagement Recycle Bin
option_A: If you delete a campaign, the prospects associated with the campaign remain in the system tagged with the deleted campaign
option_B: Tags are deleted permanently and don't appear in the recycle bin
option_C: Content files are permanently deleted and cannot be undeleted, but they are listed in the recycle bin
option_D: Content files are permanently deleted and cannot be undeleted and they are not listed in the recycle bin
option_E: Items in the recycle bin don't count toward usage limits
option_F: A deleted prospect is restored when the Salesforce record it's syncing with is undeleted
